links.outcome: AI vs expert manual echo LV mass measurement accuracy against CT reference
links.effect: AI reduced measurement error by ~20% vs expert; AUC for increased LV mass 0.78 vs 0.71 (linear) and 0.84 vs 0.77 (hybrid).
links.quote: Diagnostic accuracy for detecting increased LV mass was higher with AI echocardiography than with Expert echocardiography (AUC: 0.78 vs 0.71 for linear; 0.84 vs 0.77 for hybrid).

screen.reason: The study validates an automated AI system for quantifying LV mass on echocardiograms compared to expert manual measurements and a CT reference standard, including a test-retest reliability cohort.
